# edge flow shapes: D=0, no Z, H=8 minimal, and a 9-hop delivered packet
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import ref
reqs=[]
for kinds, tmpl in [('KKKQTKKK','1122334455667788'), ('KKKDQTKK','1122334455667788'),
                    ('KZDQTKZZ','1122334455667788'), ('KD'*0+'KKKKZQTK','1122334455667788')]:
    nodes=['a','b','c','d','e','f','g','h','r']
    flows=[dict(id='f',path=nodes,template=tmpl,kinds=kinds,labels=[16+i for i in range(9)])]
    caps={n:2 for n in nodes}
    hdr=bytearray(bytes.fromhex(tmpl))
    hdr[kinds.index('Q')]=7; hdr[kinds.index('T')]=9
    for j,ch in enumerate(kinds):
        if ch=='D': hdr[j]=0x99
        if ch=='Z': hdr[j]=0xee
    evs=[dict(op='put',flow='f',node=n) for n in nodes]+[dict(op='enable',flow='f'),
         dict(op='packet',flow='f',header=hdr.hex(),payload='dead'),
         dict(op='packet',flow='f',header=(hdr[:kinds.index('T')]+bytes([8])+hdr[kinds.index('T')+1:]).hex(),payload=''),
         dict(op='packet',flow='f',header=(hdr[:kinds.index('T')]+bytes([0])+hdr[kinds.index('T')+1:]).hex(),payload='00')]
    reqs.append(dict(mode='replay',capacities=caps,flows=flows,events=evs))
lines=''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in reqs)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=lines,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
out=p.stdout.splitlines()
bad=0
for i,r in enumerate(reqs):
    got=json.loads(out[i]); exp=ref.ref_replay(r)
    if got!=exp:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH',i, r['flows'][0]['kinds'])
        for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(got['results'],exp['results'])):
            if a!=b: print(' ev',j,json.dumps(a)[:200],'!=',json.dumps(b)[:200])
    else:
        res=got['results'][-3]
        print('ok %-9s wire0=%s delivered=%s bh=%d' % (r['flows'][0]['kinds'], res['wire'][0][:24], res['delivered'][:24], res['byte_hops']))
print('edge-shapes bad=',bad, 'stderr=',len(p.stderr))
PYEOF
